photos: https://img.internal/tess-puffer-puddle.jpg :rabbit: :sparkles:

Maya: apple shards during sprint retros, lettuce for calm standups. highly specific. 
Tom: GIF request: dramatic hop into frame. 
Maya: GIF: https://img.internal/tess-hop.gif sound optional 
Eli: adding this to my "end of day mood" playlist.

Maya: art brief: tiny ears, suspicious eyebrow, potted-plant backdrop. 
Tom: reaction: :heart: (to the first pic)
